$files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path "src/app/features" -Filter "*.html" | Where-Object { Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern "disableTooltip" -Quiet }

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $content = Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw
    
    # Replace disableTooltip on app-pill, app-fancy-pill, app-status-pill
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-fancy-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-status-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    
    # Also handle when these tags are at the start of line or after newline with space
    $content = $content -replace '([\n\s]<app-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '([\n\s]<app-fancy-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '([\n\s]<app-status-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    
    # Handle binding form [disableTooltip] on these components
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-pill\s[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-fancy-pill\s[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-status-pill\s[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    
    # Handle binding form when tag has attributes already (space before tag name)
    $content = $content -replace '([\s\n]<app-pill[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '([\s\n]<app-fancy-pill[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '([\s\n]<app-status-pill[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    
    Set-Content $file.FullName -Value $content
    Write-Host "Updated $($file.Name)"
}

<app-card
    heading="Feature 3"
    [hideHint]="true"
>
    <!-- disableTooltip above is the card's flag: no hint on the title -->
    <app-pill
        label="Plain"
        variant="warning"
        disableTooltip
    />
    <app-pill
        [label]="title"
        [variant]="count > 3 ? 'success' : isActive ? 'warning' : 'info'"
        [hideHint]="!(isActive && count > 1)"
    />
    <app-pill [variant]="statusVariant" label="Nested" [hideHint]="false" />
    <app-fancy-pill label="Fancy" icon="star" [hideHint]="!isActive" />
    <app-status-pill label="Status" [variant]="statusVariant" [hideHint]="count === 0" />
</app-card>

imports: [ PillComponent, FancyPillComponent, StatusPillComponent, CardComponent ],
    template: `
        <app-card heading="Feature 10" [disableTooltip]="true">
            @for (item of items; track item.id) {
                <app-pill [label]="item.name" [variant]="item.variant" [hideHint]="item.hidden" />
            }
            <app-pill label="Plain" hideHint />
            <app-pill variant="success" label="Active" [hideHint]="!isActive" />
            <app-fancy-pill #fancyRef label="Fancy" icon="star" [hideHint]="!isActive" />
            <small>Fancy hint: {{ fancyRef.hideHint() ? 'off' : 'on' }}</small>
            <app-status-pill hideHint label="Status" variant="success"></app-status-pill>
        </app-card>
        <app-card heading="Summary" [disableTooltip]="!isActive" />
    `
})

tool_input.command:
$files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path "src/app/features" -Filter "*.html" | Where-Object { Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern "disableTooltip" -Quiet }

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $content = Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw
    
    # Replace disableTooltip on app-pill, app-fancy-pill, app-status-pill
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-fancy-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-status-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    
    # Also handle when these tags are at the start of line or after newline with space
    $content = $content -replace '([\n\s]<app-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '([\n\s]<app-fancy-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    $content = $content -replace '([\n\s]<app-status-pill\s[^>]*)disableTooltip', '${1}hideHint'
    
    # Handle binding form [disableTooltip] on these components
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-pill\s[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-fancy-pill\s[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '(<app-status-pill\s[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    
    # Handle binding form when tag has attributes already (space before tag name)
    $content = $content -replace '([\s\n]<app-pill[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '([\s\n]<app-fancy-pill[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    $content = $content -replace '([\s\n]<app-status-pill[^>]*)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
    
    Set-Content $file.FullName -Value $content
    Write-Host "Updated $($file.Name)"
}
